## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser life-strategy game spanning careers, travel, assets, businesses, public office, royalty, and wealth progression.

## Requirements
- Include all 195 countries and flight travel.
- Support economy through “above first-class” ticket tiers.
- Include jobs, assets, businesses, public office, and royal progression.
- Provide a polished, responsive game interface.

## Decisions
- Used a single-page HTML/CSS/JavaScript implementation with localStorage saves.
- Assumed a fictional, stylized simulation rather than exhaustive real-world data.
- Added starting funds, reputation, countries, assets, income, and wealth-class progression.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the full page structure and visual system.
- Implemented 195-country directory and search.
- Implemented flight booking tiers and destination selection.
- Implemented jobs and monthly income.
- Implemented asset and business purchasing.
- Implemented public office and royalty paths.
- Implemented monthly advancement and persistence.
- Implemented responsive desktop/mobile layouts.
- Added canvas scene and world map illustrations.
- Added “next chapter” journey cards.
- Verified JavaScript syntax and browser rendering.
- Saved an initial screenshot at `screenshots/home.jpg`.

### Active
- No active development goals.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue visual and gameplay validation across additional views and mobile size.
2. Test career, travel, purchase, monthly-income, and reputation interactions.
3. Address any browser issues found during interaction testing.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/home.jpg`: Latest desktop viewport capture.
